  6143: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_mark_local_read_only(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIntegerIrLocal* local)
  6144: {
  6145:     if (local && local->place.value < builder->function->value_count)
  6146:     {
  6147:         // A parameter written with an array type is adjusted to a pointer to
  6148:         // the element type (C11 6.7.6.3p7), and a `const` in front of that
  6149:         // element type qualifies what the pointer points to rather than the
  6150:         // pointer itself. The walk in c_ir_c_type_is_read_only descends
  6151:         // through an array into its element, which is right for an array
  6152:         // object -- its elements are const, so it is not modifiable -- and
  6153:         // wrong for the pointer a parameter became. musl's `utimensat` takes
  6154:         // `const struct timespec times[2]` and assigns `times = 0`. A `const`
  6155:         // inside the brackets, `int a[const 2]`, is the one that does qualify
  6156:         // the pointer.
  6157:         bool adjusted_pointer = false;
  6158:         bool const_pointer = false;
  6159:         if (local->is_parameter && local->entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count)
  6160:         {
  6161:             CTypeId declared = builder->parse.entities[local->entity.value].type;
  6162:             if (declared.value < builder->parse.type_count && builder->parse.types[declared.value].kind == C_TYPE_ARRAY)
  6163:             {
  6164:                 CType array = builder->parse.types[declared.value];
  6165:                 adjusted_pointer = !array.is_const;
  6166:                 const_pointer = array.array_bound < builder->parse.array_bound_count && builder->parse.array_bounds[array.array_bound].is_const;
  6167:             }
  6168:         }

  6480: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_atomic_aggregate_accesses_lowerable(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
  6481: {
  6482:     IrFunction* function = builder->function;
  6483:     bool supported = true;
  6484:     // The walk exists for the six functions in a self-compile that hold an
  6485:     // atomic access; the opcode summary the builder maintained while
  6486:     // appending answers "none here" for every other one without touching a
  6487:     // row, and a summary it never established reads as "maybe", which keeps
  6488:     // the walk for hand-built IR.  Measured on the stage-1 self-host: the
  6489:     // unconditional walk was 0,5% of the compile's instructions.
  6490:     bool may_hold_atomic =
  6491:         ir_function_may_contain_opcodes(function, IR_OPCODE_BIT(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD) | IR_OPCODE_BIT(IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_STORE));
  6492:     for (u32 block_index = 0; may_hold_atomic && block_index < function->block_count && supported; block_index += 1)
  6493:     {
  6494:         IrInstructionId instruction_id = function->blocks[block_index].first_instruction;
  6495:         while (instruction_id.value != IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID && supported)
  6496:         {
  6497:             IrInstruction* instruction = function->instructions + instruction_id.value;
  6498:             bool atomic_access = instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD || instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_STORE;
  6499:             if (atomic_access && instruction->operand_count && instruction->operands[0].value < function->value_count)
  6500:             {
  6501:                 IrTypeId place_type = function->values[instruction->operands[0].value].canonical_type;
  6502:                 if (!c_ir_atomic_aggregate_access_representable(builder, place_type))
  6503:                 {
  6504:                     IrType* qualified = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, place_type);
  6505:                     builder->failure_message = string_format(
  6506:                         builder->arena, S8("C IR lowering does not support an atomic {S8} of a {u64}-byte aggregate: this target has no lock-free access that wide"),
  6507:                         instruction->opcode == IR_OPCODE_ATOMIC_LOAD ? S8("load") : S8("store"),
  6508:                         qualified && qualified->layout.resolved ? qualified->layout.size : 0);
  6509:                     builder->failure_token_index = UINT32_MAX;
  6510:                     supported = false;
  6511:                 }
  6512:             }
  6513:             instruction_id = instruction->next;
  6514:         }
  6515:     }
  6516: 
  6517:     return supported;
  6518: }

  6553:     IrTypeId bits_place_type = bits_place.value < builder->function->value_count

  6575:         *pointer_type_out = pointer_type;

  7289:         // qualification, and IR types carry no const: the flag clears, so

  7291:         // const its own accessor returned -- stores where the reference
  7292:         // compilers store.  The cost is one diagnostic, not a miscompile: a
  7293:         // cast that *adds* const is no longer refused as a store target,
  7294:         // which is the same laxity the reference compilers only warn about
  7295:         // under -Wcast-qual.  Stores through const lvalues keep their
  7296:         // refusal -- those places read their entity's own C type.

  7300:     }

  7302:     operands[0] = value;
  7303:     IrSourceRange cast_source = source;
  7304:     IrInstruction cast = c_ir_instruction_initialize(IR_OPCODE_CAST, target_type);
  7305:     cast.operands = operands;
  7306:     cast.operand_count = 1;

 11505: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_append_utf8(u8* bytes, u64 capacity, u64* count, u32 codepoint)
 11506: {
 11507:     if (codepoint > UINT32_C(0x10ffff) || (codepoint >= UINT32_C(0xd800) && codepoint <= UINT32_C(0xdfff)))
 11508:     {
 11509:         return false;
 11510:     }

 11513:     {

 13302: // entry block before any terminator is emitted. The declaration itself still
 13303: // owns initialization, cleanup activation, and VLA allocation, so a path that
 13304: // crosses it receives storage but executes none of those side effects.
 13305: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_predeclare_labeled_automatic_locals(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 start, u32 end)
 13306: {
 13307:     for (CEntityId entity = {.value = 0}; entity.value < builder->parse.entity_count; entity.value += 1)
 13308:     {
 13309:         CEntity* value = builder->parse.entities + entity.value;
 13310:         u32 declaration_token = value->declaration_token_plus_one ? value->declaration_token_plus_one - 1 : UINT32_MAX;
 13311:         if (value->kind != C_ENTITY_LOCAL || value->is_static_storage || value->is_thread_local || value->is_extern ||
 13312:             declaration_token < start || declaration_token >= end ||
 13313:             value->type.value >= builder->parse.type_count || c_ir_find_local_by_entity(builder, entity))
 13314:         {
 13315:             continue;
 13316:         }
 13317:         IrTypeId local_type = builder->c_type_ir_map[value->type.value];
 13318:         IrType* local_type_value = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, local_type);
 13319:         // Unmapped array types are VLAs. Their allocation and stack checkpoint
 13320:         // must stay at the declaration; C already forbids jumping into their
 13321:         // scope, and predeclaring a pointer would weaken that contract.

 14929: // A call to abort-like entry points terminates an ordinary body, but GNU
 14930: // statement expressions still need to hand their value/control back to the
 14931: // enclosing expression walker.  Keep the context query local to lowering so
 14932: // the call emitter can avoid inserting an early unreachable terminator in
 14933: // those nested bodies (the body walker already knows how to close them).
 14934: /* Whether something enclosing the call being lowered resumes after it, which
 14935:    is what decides that a noreturn callee may not end its block. A GNU
 14936:    statement expression is resumed by the enclosing expression frame; every
 14937:    branching expression -- `? :`, `&&`, `||`, and a lowered branch condition --
 14938:    created a merge block its arm is expected to reach. Buster's own
 14939:    BUSTER_CHECK puts a noreturn call in a conditional operand, so this is not
 14940:    a hypothetical shape. A body statement that consumes the value -- a return,
 14941:    an initializer, a switch controller -- emits its rows after the call too.
 14942:    So does an expression statement, whose call may be an operand of a cast,
 14943:    an assignment, another call or a comma: that statement is returned through
 14944:    `statement`, and it ends its block once its own rows are emitted. */

 15192: // Emit one compiler-runtime call whose ABI is fixed by the compiler rather

 24760: // A designator is a chain, not one step: C11 6.7.9p6 lets `.member`, `[index]`
 24761: // and any mix of them follow one another before the `=`. musl's mutex,
 24762: // barrier and rlimit initializers all write one -- `._m_type` is
 24763: // `__u.__i[0]` after the header's macros -- so the walk below accepts both
 24764: // step kinds and stops at the first token that is neither. It returns the

 27858: // and its off-loop direct run: consume the place child in

 27860: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_expression_core_root_update_resume(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrExpressionCoreState* state)
 27861: {
 27862:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 27863:     IrValueId place = machine->child_result.value;
 27864:     CToken update = builder->preprocess.tokens[state->pending_start];
 27865:     if (!machine->child_result.success || place.value >= builder->function->value_count)
 27866:     {

 27872:     }

 27883:         {

 31118: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrLowerFrameResult c_ir_lower_dispatch_run(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, u32 request_mark, bool outermost)
 31119: {
 31120:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 31121:     machine->run_depth += 1;
 31122:     while (machine->frame_count > request_mark && !machine->failed)
 31123:     {
 31124:         c_ir_lower_frame_fallback(builder);
 31125:     }
 31126:     machine->run_depth -= 1;
 31127:     CIrLowerFrameResult result = machine->child_result;
 31128:     result.success &= !machine->failed;
 31129:     if (outermost && machine->failed)
 31130:     {
 31131:         c_ir_lower_machine_unwind(builder);
 31132:     }
 31133:     return result;
 31134: }

 31136: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL CIrLowerFrameResult c_ir_lower_dispatch(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame root)
 31137: {
 31138:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 31139:     bool outermost = machine->run_depth == 0;
 31140:     if (outermost)
 31141:     {
 31142:         machine->root_frame_mark = machine->frame_count;
 31143:         machine->scratch_mark = builder->scratch_arena->position;
 31144:         machine->child_result = (CIrLowerFrameResult){
 31145:             .value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID,
 31146:             .index = UINT32_MAX,
 31147:         };
 31148:         machine->failed = false;
 31149:     }
 31150:     u32 request_mark = machine->frame_count;
 31151:     if (!c_ir_lower_frame_push(builder, root))
 31152:     {
 31153:         if (outermost)
 31154:         {
 31155:             c_ir_lower_machine_unwind(builder);
 31156:         }
 31157:         return (CIrLowerFrameResult){
 31158:             .value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID,
 31159:         };
 31160:     }
 31161:     return c_ir_lower_dispatch_run(builder, request_mark, outermost);
 31162: }

 32711: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_expression_task_push(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrLowerFrame* frame, CIrLowerFrame task, u32 token_index)
 32712: {
 32713:     if (!frame->as.expression.tasks)
 32714:     {
 32715:         frame->as.expression.task_capacity = frame->as.expression.end - frame->as.expression.start + 1;
 32716:         frame->as.expression.tasks = arena_allocate(builder->temporary_arena, CIrLowerFrame, frame->as.expression.task_capacity);
 32717:     }
 32718:     if (frame->as.expression.task_count >= frame->as.expression.task_capacity)
 32719:     {
 32720:         builder->failure_message = S8("C expression nesting exceeds the lowering frame capacity");
 32721:         builder->failure_token_index = token_index;
 32722:         return false;
 32723:     }
 32724:     frame->as.expression.tasks[frame->as.expression.task_count++] = task;
 32725:     return true;

 32728: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_lower_expression_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder)
 32729: {
 32730:     CIrLowerMachine* machine = &builder->lower_machine;
 32731:     BUSTER_CHECK(machine->frame_count > machine->root_frame_mark);
 32732:     CIrLowerFrame* frame = &machine->frames[machine->frame_count - 1];
 32733:     BUSTER_CHECK(frame->kind == C_IR_LOWER_FRAME_EXPRESSION);
 32734:     bool unwind = false;
 32735:     if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_BEGIN)
 32736:     {
 32737:         if (frame->as.expression.start >= frame->as.expression.end || frame->as.expression.end > builder->preprocess.token_count)
 32738:         {
 32739:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 32740:             return;
 32741:         }
 32742:         frame->as.expression.value = IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID;
 32743:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 32744:     }
 32745:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_VALUE)
 32746:     {
 32747:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
 32748:         {
 32749:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 32750:             return;
 32751:         }
 32752:         frame->as.expression.value = machine->child_result.value;
 32753:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 32754:         unwind = true;
 32755:     }
 32756:     else if (frame->stage == C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_EXPRESSION_VOID_ASSIGNMENT)
 32757:     {
 32758:         // A cast to void still evaluates an assignment for its side effect.
 32759:         // Lower the assignment through the statement machine and provide the
 32760:         // discarded value expected by the surrounding comma/expression walk.
 32761:         if (!machine->child_result.success)
 32762:         {
 32763:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 32764:             return;

 32768:         {
 32769:             c_ir_lower_frame_finish(builder, false, IR_VALUE_ID_INVALID);
 32770:             return;
 32771:         }
 32772:         frame->stage = (u8)C_IR_LOWER_STAGE_FINISH;
 32773:         unwind = true;
 32774:     }

 35056:     IrType* variable_element = variable_length_array ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, variable_element_type) : 0;

 36198: BUSTER_C_SHARED bool c_semantic_asm_fixed_operands_conflict(u64 const* constraints, u32 count)
 36199: {
 36200:     bool conflict = false;
 36201:     for (u32 operand_index = 0; !conflict && operand_index < count; operand_index += 1)
 36202:     {
 36203:         u64 constraint = constraints[operand_index];
 36204:         u64 constraint_class = constraint & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_CLASS_MASK;
 36205:         bool physical = IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_HAS_PHYSICAL_REGISTER(constraint);
 36206:         if (!physical && !IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_IS_FIXED(constraint_class))
 36207:         {
 36208:             continue;
 36209:         }
 36210:         for (u32 previous_index = 0; !conflict && previous_index < operand_index; previous_index += 1)
 36211:         {
 36212:             u64 previous_constraint = constraints[previous_index];
 36213:             u64 previous_class = previous_constraint & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_CLASS_MASK;
 36214:             bool previous_physical = IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_HAS_PHYSICAL_REGISTER(previous_constraint);
 36215:             bool same_register = physical && previous_physical
 36216:                                      ? IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_PHYSICAL_REGISTER_INDEX(constraint) ==
 36217:                                            IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_PHYSICAL_REGISTER_INDEX(previous_constraint)
 36218:                                      : !physical && !previous_physical && previous_class == constraint_class;
 36219:             if (same_register)
 36220:             {
 36221:                 bool current_output = (constraints[operand_index] & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_OUTPUT) != 0;
 36222:                 bool previous_output = (constraints[previous_index] & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_OUTPUT) != 0;
 36223:                 bool current_read_write = (constraints[operand_index] & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_READ_WRITE) != 0;
 36224:                 bool previous_read_write = (constraints[previous_index] & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_READ_WRITE) != 0;
 36225:                 bool current_early_clobber = (constraints[operand_index] & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_EARLY_CLOBBER) != 0;
 36226:                 bool previous_early_clobber = (constraints[previous_index] & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_EARLY_CLOBBER) != 0;
 36227:                 bool output_input_pair = current_output != previous_output &&
 36228:                                          ((current_output && !current_read_write && !current_early_clobber) ||
 36229:                                           (previous_output && !previous_read_write && !previous_early_clobber));
 36230:                 if (!output_input_pair)
 36231:                 {
 36232:                     conflict = true;
 36233:                 }
 36234:             }
 36235:         }
 36236:     }
 36237:     return conflict;
 36238: }

 36247: // The x87 stack is a stack rather than a set of registers, so what an asm may
 36248: // say about it is a shape rather than a per-operand fact. The emitter pushes
 36249: // the operands into their positions before the template and pops what is left
 36250: // after it, and every rule here is one that model needs to hold:
 36251: //
 36252: //   - each position is named at most once, because two operands cannot occupy
 36253: //     one slot;
 36254: //   - `u` needs a `t`, because st(1) is only st(1) when something is at st(0);
 36255: //   - an `st` clobber says the template popped what it was handed, so it comes
 36256: //     with exactly one x87 operand and that operand is an input. A popped
 36257: //     output is one the emitter would have to read back out of a register the
 36258: //     template already discarded.
 36259: BUSTER_C_SHARED String8 c_semantic_asm_x87_operands_message(u64 const* constraints, u32 count, bool stack_clobber)
 36260: {
 36261:     String8 message = {0};
 36262:     u32 top_count = 0;
 36263:     u32 below_count = 0;
 36264:     bool top_is_output = false;
 36265:     for (u32 operand_index = 0; operand_index < count; operand_index += 1)
 36266:     {
 36267:         u64 constraint = constraints[operand_index];
 36268:         u64 constraint_class = constraint & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_CLASS_MASK;
 36269:         if (constraint_class == IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_T)
 36270:         {
 36271:             top_count += 1;
 36272:             top_is_output = (constraint & IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_OUTPUT) != 0;
 36273:         }
 36274:         else if (constraint_class == IR_INLINE_ASSEMBLY_CONSTRAINT_U)
 36275:         {
 36276:             below_count += 1;
 36277:         }
 36278:     }
 36279:     if (top_count > 1 || below_count > 1)
 36280:     {
 36281:         message = S8("asm names an x87 stack position more than once");
 36282:     }
 36283:     else if (below_count && !top_count)
 36284:     {
 36285:         message = S8("an asm operand in x87 st(1) requires one in st(0)");
 36286:     }
 36287:     else if (stack_clobber && (top_count != 1 || below_count || top_is_output))
 36288:     {
 36289:         message = S8("an asm that clobbers st must take exactly one x87 input and no output");
 36290:     }
 36291:     return message;
 36292: }
